description: One record per subreddit post that passes your filters, with score, comments, flair, gilded/crosspost counts and media hints.

content.description: Text content of self posts (first 1000 characters). Null for link posts.
content.title: Content

created_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime when the post was created
created_at.title: Created At

created_utc.description: Unix timestamp when the post was created
created_utc.title: Created UTC

is_nsfw.description: Whether the post is marked as NSFW
is_nsfw.title: Is NSFW

num_comments.description: Total number of comments on the post
num_comments.title: Number of Comments

old_reddit_url.description: Permalink to the post on old.reddit.com
old_reddit_url.title: Old Reddit URL

post_name.description: Full post name in Reddit format (e.g., t3_abc123)
post_name.title: Post Name

subreddit_prefixed.description: Subreddit name with r/ prefix (e.g., r/python)
subreddit_prefixed.title: Subreddit Prefixed

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the post thumbnail image (if any)
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail URL

url.description: Permalink to the post on reddit.com
url.title: URL

title: Reddit Subreddit Post Filter & Moderation Scraper Output
